description: PLACEHOLDER for the real-bill golden fixture (METHODOLOGY.md 7 accuracy gate). While status is 'placeholder' the golden reconciliation test SKIPS this file with an explicit reason — it never silently passes. To produce the real fixture, run scripts/export-golden-fixture.py on the LAN (see its --help) with the bill month and the bill's home-charging kWh/cost figures from the Octopus bill PDF, which writes <YYYY-MM>.real.json beside this file with status 'real' (set automatically when bill figures are supplied). That file is git-ignored and kept locally: the golden test picks it up on the machine that holds it.
